title: Number of Music Playlists
description: Find the number of possible playlists of length goal given n unique songs, where each song must be played at least once and no song can be played again until k other songs have been played.

steps.note: Initialize DP table for goal=3, n=2, k=0.
Calculate dp[1][1] (1 song in list, 1 unique used): 2 choices.
Transition for dp[2][2]: using a new song.
Final calculation for goal=3, n=2, k=0.
